summary: First test run for ReplyRush MVP. Backend: 18/20 pytest cases pass. Frontend: full happy-path works with localStorage rr_token auth (Landing, Dashboard analytics/urgency chips/Issue Radar/5 platform cards, Connect flow with sorted cards, Reply Studio generate producing on-topic reply, History with filters). One CRITICAL backend bug: /api/issue-radar/theme/{theme} returns 404 for any theme that contains a '/' (Delivery/Wait time, Staff/Service, Refund/Billing, Cleanliness/Environment) because FastAPI does not accept encoded %2F in a path parameter. This breaks the Theme Drawer's suggested_action for 4 of 8 themes (confirmed visually - drawer opens but suggested-action never renders and browser network shows 404). Language matching (ES/FR) and honesty rule (no invented refund/contact/discount) verified on the LLM output.

critical.issue: Returns 404 for themes containing '/', e.g. 'Delivery/Wait time', 'Staff/Service', 'Refund/Billing', 'Cleanliness/Environment'. Starlette treats %2F as literal '/' in routing so the path parameter never matches. Confirmed both locally on :8001 and via ingress. Frontend ThemeDrawer calls encodeURIComponent(theme) and gets 404 for 4/8 themes. Fix options: (a) change route to Query param, e.g. GET /api/issue-radar/theme?theme=... ; (b) accept the theme as path:path with a custom converter; (c) URL-safe-encode themes on the client (e.g. replace '/' with '__slash__' both sides).

minor.issue: Intermittently returned a non-JSON body on the immediate 2nd call in the same second (observed 1x during parallel pytest run). Retry immediately succeeded via curl and playwright. Likely a transient LLM/proxy hiccup, not a code bug. Add a simple 502 retry or defensive JSON parse if this recurs.

ui_bugs.issue: Drawer opens but 'theme-suggested-action' never renders because backend returns 404 for slash-containing themes. Also drawer shows blank body (no reviews list, no action). Root cause is backend routing; frontend also needs an empty/error state.
Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Chart still renders after resize but signals a missing min-height on the ResponsiveContainer.
React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'.

integration_issues.issue: Click radar-theme-Delivery-Wait-time -> API GET /api/issue-radar/theme/Delivery%2FWait%20time -> 404 -> drawer body empty.

issues: Hero, 3-step visual, Get Started and Sign In all present and render cleanly.

Add empty/error state in ThemeDrawer when the API errors.
Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer min-height and add DialogContent aria-describedby to silence warnings.

rca of the issue: FastAPI/Starlette resolves path params by splitting on '/'. Percent-encoded %2F in the request path is preserved as literal '/' during routing, so `/api/issue-radar/theme/Delivery%2FWait%20time` never matches `/issue-radar/theme/{theme}`. Reproduction: `curl http://localhost:8001/api/issue-radar/theme/Delivery%2FWait%20time -H 'Authorization: Bearer test_session_replyrush'` -> {"detail":"Not Found"}. Themes without '/' (e.g. 'Other') return 200. Mitigation: switch to Query param `?theme=` OR use `path:` converter OR slugify themes.
